name: benetics
description: Jobsite management for construction: tasks, punch lists, plans, and jobsite photos from the voice-first app your crews actually use, ready to combine with your other tools in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your jobsite into ChatGPT. Benetics AI is jobsite management for construction and connects the jobsite with the office: tasks, punch lists, plans, and jobsite photos, documented by your crews by voice in over 100 languages and any dialect.

• Read: projects, tasks and punch list items, plans and drawings, documents, and jobsite photos.
• Write: create projects and update their details; create and update tasks and punch list items; and add people to projects.
• Combine: turn jobsite data and your other connected tools into client updates, schedules, and summaries.
• Stay in control: changes to tasks, people, plans, documents, and photos are saved as drafts that you review and publish in Benetics AI. Creating or updating a project takes effect right away.

Used by more than 5,000 construction teams.
capabilities: Read projects, tasks, plans, documents, and photos
Create projects and update their details
Propose drafts for task changes, new tasks, plans, documents and photos
Propose project and organization members as drafts
defaultPrompt: Which tasks are overdue on my project?
Summarize this week's open punch list items by assignee.
Create a task to fix the damaged door on the ground floor.

positive.prompt: Which tasks are overdue on my project?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which project if the user has several, then lists the open tasks that are past their due date, with assignee and due date.

positive.prompt: Summarize all punch list items by assignee.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which project if the user has several, then gives a summary grouped by assignee with a count per person, using only tasks returned by the tools.

positive.prompt: Create a task to fix the damaged door on the ground floor.
positive.expected_behavior: Stages a new task as a draft and says it is a draft that changes nothing until the user reviews and publishes it in the Benetics app.

positive.prompt: Move the due date of the 'Cover with sand' task to next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task, stages the new due date as a draft, states the new date and says it is a draft that changes nothing until the user reviews and publishes it in the Benetics app.

positive.prompt: What plans and documents do we have for my project?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which project if the user has several, then lists the project's plans and documents by name.

positive.prompt: Create a project called Seefeld Renovation at Seefeldstrasse 12, 8008 Zurich.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which organization should own the project if the user belongs to several, checks that no project of that name exists yet, then creates it and says that it was created right away, not as a draft, with a link to it.
Finds the project and asks the user to confirm before archiving it, since the change is immediate and affects everyone on the project. Once confirmed, archives it and says that it can be restored.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no Benetics tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Zurich tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported action: the plugin cannot send email. ChatGPT should say so and offer the list in the conversation instead.
negative.prompt: Email the overdue task list to the site manager.

negative.description: Direct deletion: the plugin cannot delete a task directly. At most it stages a deletion draft with propose_task_deletion and says the task is only deleted once the user publishes the draft in the Benetics app.
negative.prompt: Delete the 'Cover with sand' task, no draft.

negative.description: Project deletion: the plugin cannot delete a project. ChatGPT should say so, and may offer to archive it with update_project instead.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Create projects and update their details. These changes take effect right away; all other changes are still proposed as drafts that you review in Benetics AI.
